claim: Isaac Herzog, president of Israel since 2021, appears in the Epstein documents once, on a distribution list written by someone else. On November 16, 2015 Melanie Spinella, executive assistant to Apollo Global Management co-founder Leon Black, sent word that Black's sister Judy Ellen Black had died the previous day, with the graveside funeral and shiva details. The recipient list runs to dozens of names — Robert Kraft, Michael Milken, Richard LeFrak, Carl Icahn, Stephen Schwarzman, Thomas H. Lee, David Stockman and others — and includes both "Isaac Herzog" and Jeffrey Epstein's jeevacation@gmail.com address. Epstein forwarded it onward the same day. The document is Bates EFTA00840600 in Data Set 9 of the Department of Justice release. It places the two names on a single bereavement notice circulated by a third party. It records no contact between them.

sources.label: DOJ Epstein Files Transparency Act production, Data Set 9, Bates EFTA00840600 — November 16, 2015 notice from Leon Black's office, forwarded by Epstein.
sources.quote: It is with sadness that I am letting you know that Judy Ellen Black, loving wife of Richard Schlosberg and dear sister of Leon Black assed away Sunday, November 15th.

notes: Backstage. Herzog is the weakest link in the circulating Israeli-leadership list and it is worth separating from the rest of it, because the others are not weak in the same way: Ehud Barak's contact with Epstein is documented at scale in the Israeli press and in the files, and Yoni Koren appears repeatedly in the corpus. Herzog appears on one shiva notice among roughly sixty recipients, sent by Leon Black's assistant. Naming the other people on the list is deliberate — it shows what kind of list it is. Group A on the correction; the broader claim of a dozen high-level Israeli connections is Group B.
